11.t: Working with data: a journey to school
q: How far is school from Minh’s home?
What was Minh doing between 5 and 8 minutes?
Stopped (the line is flat), for example at traffic lights.
Calculate Minh’s speed in the first 5 minutes in m per minute.
1200 / 5 = 240 m per minute (4 m per s).
Calculate Minh’s average speed for the whole journey and explain why it is lower than his speed in the first 5 minutes.
3000 m / 20 min = 150 m per minute (2.5 m per s). The average includes the 3-minute stop and the slower sections, so it is lower.
